melek_sites.note: distinguish from melakhot 'queens' (below) before counting any king-digit

dodi_exact.count_object: verses bearing דודי/ודודי/לדודי exact tokens (her word for the man)

dod_family.note: family sweep ≠ dodi count ≠ token count: name the object before any digit

dadeikha_defective.count_object: verses bearing the DEFECTIVE dodekha spelling דדיך/דדי ('your loves', 1:2, 1:4, 4:10, 7:13)
dadeikha_defective.note: escapes every dod-sweep (no vav) — the Song digit-blending hazard's sharpest arm

dudaim_mandrakes.note: dod-adjacent homograph; never blend with beloved-counts

rayati.count_object: verses bearing רעיתי 'my love [f.]' (his word for the woman)

rea_shepherd_family.note: resh-ayin family: ra'yati (address) / ro'eh (graze) / ra' (evil, absent) — name the object

achoti.note: 8:8 achot is the brothers' little sister — NOT the bride epithet; role-split before counting

ahavah_noun.count_object: verses bearing the noun ahavah (letter-prefix tolerant)

sheahavah_nafshi.count_object: verses bearing the she-ahavah nafshi relative formula ('whom my soul loves')

ani.count_object: verses bearing אני/ואני exact tokens (first-person pronoun)

banot_yerushalaim.count_object: verses bearing the adjacent pair בנות ירושלם

banot_tsiyon.count_object: verses bearing the adjacent pair בנות ציון (3:11 only)

banot_any.count_object: verses bearing any banot token (incl. the two address formulas above)

adjuration_refrain.count_object: verses bearing hishba'ti 'I adjure' (hiphil, shin) — the adjuration sites
adjuration_refrain.note: 2:7 and 3:5 carry the FULL form (daughters + gazelles/does + im-ta'iru); 5:8 is the im-timtse'u / mah-tagidu variant WITHOUT the gazelles; 8:4 uses mah-ta'iru WITHOUT the gazelles — three attested shapes, never conflated

mutual_belonging_refrain.count_object: verses bearing one of the three attested mutual-belonging formulas (byte-matched skeleton phrases)
mutual_belonging_refrain.note: the three shapes DIFFER (order flip 2:16 vs 6:3; the 7:11 desire-variant sits in the OFFSET ZONE = WEB 7:10) — quote the attested shape, never a harmonized one

tsvi_family.note: bi-tseva'ot in the adjurations = 'by the gazelles' — homograph with tseva'ot 'hosts'; the divine-name reading is NOT in these bytes

foxes.count_object: verses bearing fox-tokens (2:15: shu'alim twice — 'foxes, little foxes')

qol_dodi.count_object: verses opening/bearing the qol dodi phrase (2:8, 5:2)

ad_sheyafuach.count_object: verses bearing the ad-she-yafuach ha-yom refrain (2:17, 4:6)

mi_zot.count_object: verses bearing the mi-zot ascending-question formula (3:6, 6:10, 8:5)

henetsu_rimmonim.count_object: verses bearing the henetsu ha-rimmonim clause (6:11, 7:13 — both spellings)

wasf_signal.count_object: suffixed body-part tokens per MT verse (2fs -kh / 3ms -o classes; heuristic stem list)
wasf_signal.note: STAGING SIGNAL ONLY (writers re-derive; heuristic, never row evidence): maximal runs of >=3 consecutive body-part-bearing verses. The derived zones are the byte-grounded wasf candidates; exact wasf BOUNDS are writer territory argued from bytes (openers, closures, addressee shifts).

yhwh_tetragrammaton.note: ZERO (byte-swept). ANY tetragrammaton citation in Song is a fabrication.

elohim.note: ZERO (byte-swept). Song carries no elohim/YHWH at all — cite the absence WITH this sweep; the sole Yah-form surface is the 8:6 crux below.

shalhevet_yah_8_6.count_object: the adjacent staged-token pair shalhevet + yah (MT 8:6)
shalhevet_yah_8_6.note: The underlying WLC text writes ONE word (OSHB's own 8:6 note: 'A single word in the text has been divided for exegesis'); OSHB divides it into שלהבת + יה and TAGS the second element as lemma 3050 Yah (HNp) — single-witness TAGGING metadata, not text bytes. So the staged extract carries a standalone יה token at MT 8:6 that a naive divine-name sweep hits. The construal (intensive suffix 'mighty flame' vs divine element 'flame of Yah') is a CLASSIC CRUX: hold, never decide; never cite as a divine-name occurrence without the crux AND the one-word/divided-token disclosure.

shin_bet_ayin_census.count_object: verses bearing ANY token containing the שבע letter sequence (blind contiguous sweep — for the hazard catalog)
shin_bet_ayin_census.note: EVERY Song hit is the OATH root: hishba'ti at 2:7/3:5/5:8/8:4 PLUS the daughters' quoted-back shehishba'tanu at 5:9 (which the adjuration-site count rightly EXCLUDES — it reports the oath, it does not swear one) — no 'seven' and no 'sated' tokens exist in Song: a blended שבע digit is meaningless here; name the root AND the speech role before counting

kerem_family.count_object: verses bearing vineyard kerem-family tokens (karmel EXCLUDED)

karmel.note: כרם is CONTAINED in כרמל — word-bind or byte-check every vineyard sweep

ayin_gedi.note: עין = eye AND spring: the En-Gedi ayin is not an eye-token; role-split eye-counts

pardes.count_object: verses bearing the Persian loan pardes (4:13)

yayin_family.count_object: verses bearing wine yayin-family tokens (incl. suffixed yeini 5:1 — final/medial nun allography)

mor_family.count_object: verses bearing myrrh mor-family tokens BOTH spellings (plene מור; DEFECTIVE מר at 1:13, 4:14)
mor_family.note: the defective spelling collides with mar 'bitter' (absent in Song) and escapes plene sweeps

texture_staging_signals.note: skeleton-tier shared-content-token adjacent-verse pairs per MT chapter — staging signal for the granularity gate; writers re-derive; heuristic, never row evidence
